# Positioning and securing the window glass for access

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Roll the window down and use masking tape to secure it for access. [t852]

## Tools

- 10mm socket [t852]

## Tips & gotchas

- Roll the window down until two 10mm bolts align in proper holes about 3/4 of the way down. [t852]
- Use masking tape to hold the window in place while working on other components. [t852]
